- Provides a complete, portable guide covering operating model, architecture, CLI, integration workflows, installer, bundle layout, and tracked-file map all in one SKILL.md.
- Focuses on runtime behavior, guard surfaces, platform adaptation, degraded state handling, and explicit intake rules for conversion or repackaging.
- Suitable for integrators, operators, and incident investigators needing in-depth operational and integration detail without referring to separate files.
- Does not include raw source code; emphasizes usage, architecture, and operational safety.
